The full named team consists of a CEO, a Head of Electronics, and a Lead Research Chemist ('Co-founder & CEO', 'Head of Electronics', 'Lead Research Chemist' on https://anemolabs.com/team) — no compliance, regulatory affairs, quality, or clinical/legal title is present anywhere. gaps.what_goes_wrong: Medical device and diagnostics claims (disease detection, biomarker screening) attract regulatory scrutiny (e.g. MHRA/FDA classification, clinical evidence standards).
